links.outcome: Diagnostic Top-3 accuracy with versus without external retrieval grounding (ablation)
links.effect: MAP-RAG Top-3 accuracy 79.60% general practice, 80.69% ophthalmology, 87.80% internal medicine, outperforming non-retrieval and conventional RAG baselines; removing external retrieval caused the largest declines.
links.quote: Ablation analyses showed that removing external retrieval or multi-view deconstruction caused the largest performance declines, indicating that evidence retrieval and structured record decomposition were the main drivers of improvement.

unlisted_practices: Multi-view decomposition of records with hybrid sparse-dense retrieval and dynamic confidence routing to reduce token use and latency

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a novel multi-view RAG architecture (MAP-RAG) on electronic medical records across three medical specialties, performing ablation studies on its architectural components.
